add.event: 许昌银保监分局警告许昌农商行并罚款20万元
add.evidence: On 7 August 2018, the Xuchang China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (Xuchang CBIRC) issued a warning to Xuchang Rural Commercial Bank and fined it 200,000 yuan.

add.event: 开封新东方村镇银行相关信息在微信群传播，引发挤兑
add.evidence: As early as 14-15 July 2020, Zhu, a resident of Xiangfu district, Kaifeng, spread related information regarding New Oriental Country Bank of Kaifeng in a WeChat group, causing a bank run.

add.event: 银行主要股东Sun Zhenfu被政府以“严重金融犯罪”逮捕
add.evidence: In March 2022, Sun Zhenfu, the main stockholder of the banks, was arrested by the government

add.event: 涉事银行开始为50万元以上储户预约登记
add.evidence: On January 9, 2023, it was reported that the bank involved began to make an appointment to register depositors with more than 500,000 yuan.
